rule: Transport of strict order; excluded middle on identity with the primary; modus ponens
meaning: Being more a being is having a strictly higher represented degree (global calibration, OPEN), and degrees are ordered as the approach to the primary (q.3 a.5 ad 2 reading); so being more a being is approaching the primary more nearly. The primary has being: something is more a being than something (OPEN observation), so has being; if it is not the primary it falls short of the primary (strict primacy), which therefore exceeds it in being and so has being (more such has the perfection).
